fullPassage:
The early grain trade firms were active in both surplus-producing and food deficit regions, and these firms made it their business to know the state of supply and demand in both. Because this information was the key to their ____________________, these firms worked in relative secrecy, frequently built on family ties, trust, and loyalty. In addition, these firms were able to benefit from the rise of commodity exchanges and commodities futures markets that emerged in the mid-1800s. Agricultural markets are naturally unstable, due to changes in harvest size that result from variable weather patterns and other factors. Locking-in prices by buying and selling grain for future delivery helped these firms to minimize such risks. It made sense for the grain trading companies to manage their risks within a single firm that was operating in more than one country, rather than operating as independent national companies trading with each other. Their access to information in multiple markets enabled them to easily cover the risks associated with agricultural commodity trade.

* deficit: 부족

questions.passage: The early grain trade firms were active in both surplus-producing and food deficit regions, and these firms made it their business ①<u>to know</u> the state of supply and demand in both. Because this information was the key to their profitability, these firms ②<u>worked</u> in relative secrecy, frequently built on family ties, trust, and loyalty. In addition, these firms were able to benefit from the rise of commodity exchanges and commodities futures markets that ③<u>emerged</u> in the mid-1800s. Their access to information in multiple markets ④<u>enable</u> them to easily cover the risks associated with agricultural commodity trade.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ①to know(to부정사), ②worked(과거형), ③emerged(과거형)은 정상입니다. ④enable은 주어(Their access)가 3인칭 단수이고 과거 시제이므로 enabled가 올바릅니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① to know: make it their business to V
✅ ② worked: 과거 시제
✅ ③ emerged: 관계대명사절 과거동사
❌ ④ enable → enabled: 과거 시제 + 3인칭 단수
det.tip: 주어-동사 수일치와 시제: access(단수) + 과거 문맥 → enabled

questions.passage: The early grain trade firms were active in both surplus-producing and food deficit regions. Because this information was the key to their profitability, these firms worked in relative secrecy. In addition, these firms were able to benefit from the rise of commodity exchanges and commodities futures markets ①<u>that</u> emerged in the mid-1800s. Agricultural markets are naturally ②<u>unstably</u>, due to changes in harvest size ③<u>that</u> result from variable weather patterns. Locking-in prices by buying and selling grain for future delivery helped these firms ④<u>to minimize</u> such risks.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ①that(관계대명사), ③that(관계대명사), ④to minimize(to부정사)는 정상입니다. ②unstably(부사)는 be동사 보어 자리이므로 형용사 unstable이 올바릅니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① that: 관계대명사
❌ ② unstably → unstable: are + 형용사
✅ ③ that: 관계대명사
✅ ④ to minimize: helped + to V
det.tip: be동사 + 보어 = 형용사. are naturally unstable (O) / unstably (X)

questions.passage: The early grain trade firms were active in both surplus-producing and food deficit regions. It made sense for the grain trading companies to manage their risks within a single firm that was operating in more than one country, rather than ①<u>operating</u> as independent national companies ②<u>trading</u> with each other. questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ①operating(병렬 -ing), ②trading(현재분사), ④associated(과거분사)는 정상입니다. ③easily의 위치가 잘못되었습니다. 'enabled them to easily cover'가 원문입니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① operating: rather than operating (병렬)
✅ ② trading: companies trading (분사)
❌ ③ easily: enabled them easily to cover → to easily cover
✅ ④ associated: risks associated with
det.tip: enable + O + to V: 부사는 to와 동사 사이(분리부정사)에 위치

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 단어 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ①②③은 원문 그대로입니다. ④maximize는 원문의 minimize를 반의어로 교체한 것입니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ①②③: 원문 그대로
❌ ④ maximize → minimize: 위험을 '극대화'가 아닌 '최소화'
det.tip: minimize ↔ maximize: 위험 관리 맥락에서 minimize가 적절

det.korean: ①②④는 원문 그대로입니다. ③cooperative(협력적인)는 원문의 independent(독립적인)를 교체한 것입니다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
ch: manage their risks within a single firm that was operating in more than one country

det.korean: 곡물 무역 회사들이 여러 나라에서 운영되는 하나의 회사 내에서 위험을 관리하는 것이 합리적이었습니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① manage their risks within a single firm: 원문 표현
❌ ② 각 나라에 별도 사무소: independent companies와 유사 (rather than 뒤 내용)
❌ ③ 국내 시장에만 집중: multiple markets와 모순
❌ ④ 기밀 정보 공유: secrecy와 모순

이 회사들은 가족 유대, 신뢰, 충성심에 기반하여 비밀리에 운영되었다.
곡물 무역 회사들은 정보를 공개적으로 공유했다.

det.korean: ③ 원문의 'worked in relative secrecy, frequently built on family ties, trust, and loyalty'와 일치합니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ 가족 유대, 신뢰, 충성심 기반 비밀 운영: 원문과 일치
❌ ① '에서만' → both 양쪽
❌ ② '1900년대 초' → mid-1800s
❌ ④ '공개적으로' → secrecy
det.tip: both A and B = 둘 다. 시기(mid-1800s)와 '~만(only)' 함정 주의

ch: 독립적 국가별 회사 운영이 더 효율적이었다.
곡물 무역 회사는 여러 나라에서 운영되는 단일 기업으로 위험을 관리했다.

det.korean: ④ 원문의 'manage their risks within a single firm that was operating in more than one country'와 일치합니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ 단일 기업으로 다국적 운영하여 위험 관리: 원문과 일치
❌ ① 안정적 → unstable(불안정)
❌ ② 증가 → minimize(최소화)

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 부분이 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?
ch: 각 나라의 법률에 맞춰 별도 법인을 설립해야 한다.

det.korean: 밑줄 친 부분은 '하나의 회사에서 여러 나라를 운영하는 것이 독립적 국가별 회사보다 합리적'이라는 의미로, 다국적 통합 운영이 위험 분산에 효과적이라는 뜻입니다.

questions.passage: The early grain trade firms were active in both surplus-producing and food deficit regions, and these firms made it their business to know the state of supply and demand in both. Because this information was the key to their profitability, these firms worked in relative secrecy, frequently built on family ties, trust, and loyalty. In addition, these firms were able to benefit from the rise of commodity exchanges and commodities futures markets that emerged in the mid-1800s.

questions.passage: It made sense for the grain trading companies to manage their risks within a single firm. Their access to information in multiple markets enabled them to easily __________ (association) the risks associated with agricultural commodity trade.
questions.stem:
괄호 안의 단어를 문맥에 맞는 적절한 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오.

(힌트: 괄호 안 단어와 같은 어근을 가진 다른 단어를 쓸 것)

det.korean: 이 문제는 함정입니다. association이 아닌 원문의 cover가 빈칸에 들어갑니다. 'the risks associated with'에서 associated는 이미 문장에 있으므로, 동사 자리에는 'cover(상쇄하다)'가 올바릅니다.
det.analysis:
enabled them to easily __________ the risks → cover(동사: 상쇄하다)
association과 같은 어근 → associated(이미 문장에 있음) → cover가 빈칸의 동사
det.tip: cover the risks = 위험을 상쇄하다. associated with = ~와 관련된 (과거분사)
